source:
选择施法距离内你能看到的一个5尺立方空间。一匹中型元素战驹从旋转的疾风中显现，并朝你选择的方向直线冲锋，最远可冲锋60尺。如果战驹出现在一个中型或更小生物所占据的空间内，该生物必须通过一次敏捷豁免，否则会被战驹带着一起移动。生物可以选择主动失败这次豁免。
每个处于战驹移动路径上的生物（不包括被它携带的生物，如果有的话）必须进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败受到6d8点钝击伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。之后战驹消失。
升环施法。当你使用五环或更高法术位施展该法术时，每比四环高一环伤害增加1d8。
target:
Choose a 5-foot cube you can see within range. A Medium elemental steed appears from swirling wind and charges in a straight line in a direction you choose, up to 60 feet. If the steed appears in a space occupied by a Medium or smaller creature, that creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be carried along with it. A creature can choose to fail this save.
Each creature in the steed's path, other than any creature it is carrying, must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d8 Bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one. The steed then disappears.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. When you cast this spell with a level 5 or higher spell slot, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4.
note: The appearance-space size gate, voluntary failure, straight-line charge and carried-creature damage exclusion are retained.

source:
即使敌人尚未死亡，你也能将它们送入坟墓。施法距离内一个站在地面上的你可见生物必须进行一次力量豁免。若豁免失败，则地面开裂并吞没目标，将其埋葬入至多10尺深的地下。在被埋葬期间，目标具有全身掩护，陷入束缚和目盲状态，并且无法呼吸。若豁免成功，则目标陷入倒地状态，并且其速度为0，直至其下一回合结束。被埋葬的生物可以通过使用其动作进行一次DC15的力量（运动）检定来尝试从坟墓中掘出。检定成功时，它向地表掘进5尺。检定成功且差值为5或更高时，则其到达地表。当该生物到达地表时，它会以倒地状态从地面出来。 
如果目标站在任意厚度的石头或金属上，或者至少2寸厚的木头上，则其在该豁免检定中自动成功。
target:
You can send your enemies to the grave even before they die. One creature you can see within range that is standing on the ground must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the ground splits open and swallows the target, burying it up to 10 feet underground. While buried, the target has Total Cover, has the Restrained and Blinded conditions, and cannot breathe. On a successful save, the target has the Prone condition and its Speed is 0 until the end of its next turn. A buried creature can use its action to attempt a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check to dig itself out of the grave. On a success, it digs 5 feet toward the surface. If it succeeds by 5 or more, it reaches the surface. When it reaches the surface, it emerges from the ground with the Prone condition.
If the target is standing on stone or metal of any thickness, or wood at least 2 cun thick, it automatically succeeds on this saving throw.
note: Bare cun is retained without conversion. Failed and successful save branches, the separate excavation check and success-by-5 shortcut are preserved.

source: 你发出一声原始的嚎叫，召唤低等生物听从你的命令。当你施展此法术时，源自你的100尺光环区域内的每个野兽都必须进行一次感知豁免。若豁免失败，则目标陷入魅惑状态，能够理解你的命令，并且在其下一回合内尽可能地遵循这些命令。在你的随后回合内，你可以使用魔法动作下达新的命令。若豁免成功，则目标陷入魅惑状态，直至你的下一回合开始，但是你无法进一步命令它。该嚎叫最远300尺内都能听见。
context: column:M;spell:Call of the Wild;book:歪曲之月;level:4
target: You give a primal howl, calling lesser creatures to obey your commands. When you cast this spell, each Beast in a 100-foot aura originating from you must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the Charmed condition, can understand your commands, and follows them to the best of its ability during its next turn. On your subsequent turns, you can take a Magic action to issue new commands. On a successful save, the target has the Charmed condition until the start of your next turn, but you cannot command it further. The howl can be heard up to 300 feet away.
note: The source explicitly charms even on a successful save; this shorter branch and its prohibition on further commands are retained without substituting a different rule.

source:
你使施法距离内一个你可见的生物爆燃起贪饕的无情烈焰。目标必须进行一次敏捷豁免。若豁免失败，则目标受到2d8火焰伤害和2d8暗蚀或光耀伤害（施法时选择），并且灼灼烈焰会持续燃烧。若豁免成功，则目标仅受到一半伤害。 
在烈焰持续燃烧期间，目标会在自己每个回合开始时再次受到该伤害。目标或目标触及距离内的其他生物可以使用动作让目标重复该豁免，豁免成功则终止该法术。 
被此法术的伤害杀死的生物会连同其穿戴或携带的任何非魔法装备一起化为灰烬。
target:
You cause greedy, relentless flames to erupt around one creature you can see within range. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 2d8 Fire damage and 2d8 Necrotic or Radiant damage, chosen when you cast the spell, and the intense flames continue to burn. On a successful save, it takes only half as much damage.
While the flames continue to burn, the target takes this damage again at the start of each of its turns. The target, or another creature within reach of it, can use an action to let the target repeat the saving throw, ending the spell on a success.
A creature killed by this spell's damage turns to ash, along with any nonmagical equipment it is wearing or carrying.
note: Persistent burning belongs to the failed initial save branch. Repeated damage, another creature helping with the repeat save and the equipment restriction are preserved.

source:
你召唤并释放出一群致命的乌鸦。以你为源点的30尺锥状区域内的每个你选择的生物都必须进行一次敏捷豁免。若豁免失败，则目标受到5d6力场伤害，并陷入目盲状态。若豁免成功，则目标仅受到一半伤害。目盲的生物在其每个回合结束时重复该豁免，豁免成功则终止自身该效应。如果该生物恢复任何生命值，效应也会终止。鸦群会在发动袭击后分散并消失。 
升环施法。使用的法术位每比四环高一环，伤害就增加1d6。
target:
You summon and unleash a deadly flock of crows. Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot Cone originating from you must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 5d6 Force damage and has the Blinded condition. On a successful save, it takes only half as much damage. A Blinded creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. The effect also ends if the creature regains any Hit Points. The flock scatters and disappears after attacking.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 4.
note: Blindness is restricted to the failed save; the independent healing termination and end-of-turn repeats are retained.

source:
施法距离内一个你可见的生物必须进行一次感知豁免，豁免失败则在持续时间内陷入魅惑状态。 
魔法性的提线木偶的丝线附着在被魅惑生物的肢体或躯干上。它必须在自己回合内使用动作，对你以精神选择的除自身以外的一个其他生物进行一次近战攻击，如有必要会移动以触及目标。若你未选择其他生物，或目标移动后仍然无法触及所选生物，则目标可在自己回合内正常行动。目标在其每个回合结束时重复该豁免，豁免成功则终止自身该法术。 
在你的后续回合中，你必须使用附赠动作来维持对目标的控制，否则该法术终止。
target:
One creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw, having the Charmed condition for the duration on a failed save.
Magical puppet strings attach to the Charmed creature's limbs or torso. On its turn, it must use its action to make a melee attack against one other creature, other than itself, that you mentally choose, moving to reach that creature if necessary. If you choose no other creature, or if the target still cannot reach the chosen creature after moving, the target can act normally on its turn. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.
On your subsequent turns, you must use a Bonus Action to maintain control of the target, or the spell ends.
note: The compulsory attack, movement and normal-action exceptions are translated separately; each later caster turn requires a Bonus Action to maintain control.

source: 你触碰另一个生物，并对其施加一道诅咒，汲取其活力转移给自己。目标必须进行一次魅力豁免。若豁免失败，则目标在持续时间内被诅咒。被诅咒期间，目标的攻击检定和属性检定必须减去1d4，并且当目标受到伤害时，你可以使用反应获得10临时生命值。若豁免成功，则你获得5临时生命值，并且目标的属性检定必须减去1d4，直至你的下一回合开始。
target: You touch another creature and lay a curse on it, siphoning its vitality into yourself. The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, it is cursed for the duration. While cursed, it must subtract 1d4 from its attack rolls and ability checks, and when it takes damage, you can use a Reaction to gain 10 Temporary Hit Points. On a successful save, you gain 5 Temporary Hit Points, and the target must subtract 1d4 from its ability checks until the start of your next turn.
note: The success branch affects ability checks only, and grants 5 Temporary Hit Points without adding the failed-branch reaction or attack penalty.

source: 你以施法距离内一点为中心，创造出一个闪烁微弱光芒的20尺球状区域。你和你选择的至多等于你施法属性调整值的生物（至少1个其他生物）可以从该球状区域吸收护佑魔法。当任何被选中的生物在该区域内完成一次长休时，球状区域消失，在剩余持续时间内，这些生物的AC会获得+1加值。未在球状区域内完成一次长休的被选中生物不会获得增益。
context: column:M;spell:Sanctum of the Shepherd;book:歪曲之月;level:4
target: You create a faintly glimmering 20-foot Sphere centered on a point within range. You and a number of creatures you choose up to your spellcasting ability modifier, with a minimum of one other creature, can draw protective magic from the Sphere. When any chosen creature finishes a Long Rest within the area, the Sphere disappears, and these creatures gain a +1 bonus to AC for the remainder of the duration. A chosen creature that has not finished a Long Rest within the Sphere does not gain the benefit.
note: The Sphere disappears when any chosen creature finishes the rest, but only those that completed a Long Rest inside benefit. No simultaneity or new rest requirement is invented.

source:
你为你触碰的武器注入炼狱的祝福。直到法术结束之前，武器都会熄灭半径30尺内的任何普通*光源。此外，用这把武器命中时会造成额外2d6暗蚀伤害。如果该武器原先是非魔法武器，则在法术持续时间内其将暂时转变为魔法武器。
持握此武器期间，在你自己的回合中以一个附赠动作，你可以提前结束这个法术并使武器迸发黑暗能量。每个位于武器30尺内由选择的生物必须进行一次感知豁免检定。豁免失败则生物将受到4d6暗蚀伤害，并陷入恐慌，持续1分钟。豁免成功则只承受一半伤害并不会陷入恐慌。陷入恐慌的生物在其每个回合结束时重复豁免，成功则终止其身上的该效应。
target:
You imbue a weapon you touch with an infernal blessing. Until the spell ends, the weapon extinguishes any ordinary* light source within a 30-foot radius. In addition, a hit with this weapon deals an extra 2d6 Necrotic damage. If the weapon was nonmagical, it temporarily becomes magical for the spell's duration.
While holding the weapon, you can use a Bonus Action on your turn to end this spell early and cause the weapon to erupt with dark energy. Each creature you choose within 30 feet of the weapon must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 4d6 Necrotic damage and has the Frightened condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, it takes only half as much damage and is not Frightened. A Frightened creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
note: The unexplained asterisk after ordinary is preserved. The source has a damaged chooser phrase; you choose follows the surrounding caster instruction without changing its targets. All damage and fear branches remain distinct.

source:
你在施法距离内一块固体表面上创造出一面暗蚀能量墙。你可以选择创造长不过60尺、高不过20尺、厚不过1尺的直线型能量墙；或是直径不过20尺、高不过20尺、厚不过1尺的环形能量墙。能量墙不透明，且将持续存在至法术终止。
能量墙出现时，所有位于能量墙区域内的生物必须进行一次体质豁免。豁免失败则将受到4d8暗蚀伤害。豁免成功则伤害减半。 
施展该法术时，你选择能量墙的哪一侧会造成伤害。生物在能量墙伤害侧10尺内或在能量墙区域内结束其回合时，将受到5d8暗蚀伤害。在一个回合内首次进入能量墙区域或在能量墙区域内结束其回合时也会受到同样的伤害。能量墙的另一侧不会造成伤害。每当生物受到能量墙伤害时，你能够以反应获得等于墙造成伤害量的临时生命值。
target:
You create a wall of necrotic energy on a solid surface within range. You can make a straight wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ring-shaped wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall is opaque and lasts until the spell ends.
When the wall appears, each creature in its area must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d8 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.
When you cast the spell, choose which side of the wall deals damage. A creature that ends its turn within 10 feet of the damaging side or inside the wall takes 5d8 Necrotic damage. A creature also takes the same damage when it enters the wall's area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. The wall's other side deals no damage. Whenever a creature takes damage from the wall, you can use a Reaction to gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the damage the wall dealt.
note: The source repeats the end-inside trigger; both sentences are retained, without inventing a double-damage adjudication. Initial 4d8 and later 5d8 remain different.

source:
你将自己变为一道闪电，并传送至多60尺至一处你可见的未占据空间。在你的起点和终点之间宽5尺线状范围内的每个生物需进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败者受到4d6闪电伤害，豁免成功则所受伤害减半。
升环施法。当你用五或更高环阶的法术位施展该法术时，每比四环高一环，伤害增加1d6，此外，你的最大传送距离增加10尺。
target:
You turn yourself into a bolt of lightning and teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Each creature in the 5-foot-wide Line between your starting point and destination must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. When you cast this spell with a level 5 or higher spell slot, for each slot level above 4, the damage increases by 1d6 and your maximum teleportation distance increases by 10 feet.
note: The line joins the actual starting point and destination; both damage and distance scale per slot level above 4.

source: 在此法术的持续时间内，当你下次使用近战武器攻击一个生物时，你的武器会击碎该生物周围环境的魔法。攻击会造成额外4d6力场伤害。如果该生物正在专注法术，专注会被打破。此外，目标身上任何三环或三环以下的法术都会终止。对于目标身上的每个四环或更高的法术，使用你的施法属性进行一次属性检定。DC等于 10+法术环阶。检定成功时，法术结束。
target: The next time you attack a creature with a melee weapon during this spell's duration, your weapon shatters the magic around that creature. The attack deals an extra 4d6 Force damage. If the creature is concentrating on a spell, its Concentration is broken. In addition, any spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a successful check, that spell ends.
note: The source says next attack rather than explicitly next hit; no hit prerequisite is added. Concentration, automatic low-level endings and individual higher-level checks are preserved.

source:
你号令温和的自然魔法来改变植物的生长。你可以在5尺的立方区域内看到的任何植物都可以呈现出你想要的任何形状。此外，如果植物是荆棘或能够生长荆棘，你可以将受影响的范围变成困难地形。
在你改变的地形内，目标每移动5尺将受到2d4穿刺伤害。
你也可以增加或减少由你产生的任何形状的植物的花、藤、叶、刺、枝、果实的数量。
一小时后，你的魔法消失，植物恢复正常形状。如果你能使用法术植物交谈 Speak with Plants（或类似的能力）来与植物交流，你也许能会说服它保留其新的形式。不同的植物有不同的情感和态度。
如果变形后的形态与它自然的形态大保留不相符，它保留该形态的兴致会下降。若植物同意，在dm决定下，它将保留该形态。在这种情况下，该法术将造成永久效果。
升环施法。当你使用5环或更高环阶的法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比4环高一环，就可以多5立方尺影响范围。
context: column:M;spell:Shape Plants;book:谦卑林战役设定集;level:4
target:
You call on gentle nature magic to alter the growth of plants. Any plants you can see in a 5-foot cube can take any shape you desire. In addition, if the plants are thorny or capable of growing thorns, you can turn the affected area into Difficult Terrain.
A target takes 2d4 Piercing damage for every 5 feet it moves through the terrain you altered.
You can also increase or decrease the number of flowers, vines, leaves, thorns, branches, and fruits on any plant shape you create.
After one hour, your magic fades and the plants return to their normal shapes. If you can communicate with the plants using Speak with Plants or a similar ability, you might persuade them to retain their new forms. Different plants have different feelings and attitudes.
A plant is less inclined to retain a shape that differs greatly from its natural form. If the plant agrees, it retains the shape at the DM's discretion. In this case, the spell's effect is permanent.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. When you cast this spell with a level 5 or higher spell slot, you can affect an additional 5 cubic feet for each slot level above 4.
note: The damaged natural-form sentence is rendered conservatively as differing greatly. Initial 5-foot cube and later 5 cubic feet are deliberately distinct, following the source rather than normalizing their dimensions.

source:
你创造出两颗围绕你运转的小星星。它们会在以你为中心的10尺范围内散发出微光光照。星星会保护你，如果你周围5尺内的生物以近战攻击命中你，它必须成功进行一次感知豁免，否则每颗环绕你的星星都会对其造成 1d8的光耀伤害。
每回合一次，在你的回合里，你可以使用你的动作使一颗星星向敌人飞去，让它在刺眼的闪光中爆炸并消耗它的能量。你对120尺内一敌人进行一次远程法术攻击，命中造成 4d8的光耀伤害，然后目标必须成功进行一次体质豁免，否则会陷入目盲，直到你的下一回合开始。
当法术持续时间结束、你陷入昏迷或者你耗尽了所有的星星时法术结束。
升环施法。当你使用5环或更高环阶的法术位施展该法术时，每比4环高1环，你便可额外创造一颗星星，每增加一颗星星会令以你为中心的微光光照半径增加5尺。
context: column:M;spell:Stellar Bodies;book:谦卑林战役设定集;level:4
target:
You create two small stars that orbit you. They shed Dim Light within 10 feet of you. The stars protect you: if a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d8 Radiant damage from each star orbiting you.
Once per turn, on your turn, you can use your action to send a star flying at an enemy, expending its energy in a dazzling explosion. Make a ranged spell attack against an enemy within 120 feet. On a hit, it takes 4d8 Radiant damage and must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Blinded condition until the start of your next turn.
The spell ends when its duration expires, you have the Unconscious condition, or you expend all the stars.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. When you cast this spell with a level 5 or higher spell slot, you create one additional star for each slot level above 4. Each additional star increases the radius of Dim Light around you by 5 feet.
note: The per-star retaliation and separately expended attack star are retained. The blindness save follows a successful spell attack; the source uses Unconscious, not Incapacitated.

source:
你唱着尖利的曲调，将暗影编织成一张巨大的、不断增长的网。
你选择施法距离内一点，该区域20尺立方的区域充满了暗影，该区域被轻微遮蔽，并为里面的任何生物提供了半身掩护。你可以在专注期间每一轮在施法距离内创造一个新的立方体，在这种情况下，前一个立方体在1轮后消失。立方体可以重叠，但效果不会叠加。
每个进入该区域或在该区域开始其回合的生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败时，除非它停留在该区域或者检定成功否则就会陷入失能。因此失能的生物每轮可以进行一次力量检定对抗你的法术豁免DC，检定成功则不再失能。
昼明术Daylight可以移除一处单一的20尺立方体暗影。
target:
You sing a shrill tune, weaving shadows into a vast, growing web.
Choose a point within range. A 20-foot cube there fills with shadow, becoming Lightly Obscured and providing Half Cover to any creature inside. While concentrating, you can create a new cube within range each round, in which case the previous cube disappears after 1 round. Cubes can overlap, but their effects do not stack.
Each creature that enters the area or starts its turn there must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it has the Incapacitated condition unless it remains in the area or succeeds on the check. A creature Incapacitated in this way can make a Strength check against your spell save DC once per round, no longer being Incapacitated on a successful check.
Daylight can remove a single 20-foot cube of shadow.
note: The source says unless it remains in the area, an apparently contradictory exception. It is retained literally rather than silently changed to leaves the area; a source clarification is needed. Cube replacement and per-round check timing remain unchanged.

target:

On each of your turns for the duration, you can use a Bonus Action to call up lightning and open the storm door this way again, choosing a different destination each time. 此法术可瞬间召唤一道闪耀的月光将你所选择的一个睡眠的生物或物件传送到你选择的目的地。如果你的目标是一名非自愿的生物，则需进行一次感知豁免。 如果豁免成功则法术失败，而施法者将出现在目标位置。 被转移的生物会在到达目的地后立即醒来。如果你的目标是一个物件，则必须能完全容纳在一个10英尺立方体内，而且不能被非自愿的生物持握或携带。你选择的目的地必须是你所知道的，并且必须与你在同一位面上。你对目的地的熟悉程度决定了生物或物件是否成功抵达目的地。DM掷d20并参考下面的月之转移表，以下定义会有所帮助： 
“林地或法阵Grove or Magic Circle” 是指神圣的德鲁伊林地或你所知符文序列的永久的传送法阵。 
“纪念品Memento”是指你持有一件在过去六个月内从目标地点取来的物件，例如某个法师图书馆内的一本书，某个皇家卧室里床上的亚麻线或某巫妖陵墓里的一块大理石。 
“非常熟悉”指的是你常去的地方，你仔细研究过的地方，或是你在施展该法术时能看见的地方。 
“偶尔见过” 指你见过几次的地方，但你不是很熟悉。 
“见过一次”指你只见过一次的地方，包括通过魔法看到的地点 。
“听过描述” 指一个你从别人那里听来位置和外观的地点，比如从地图上看来的地点 。 
“查无此地”指根本不存在的地点。也许你尝试探知敌人的密室但看到的只是幻象，或者是一个你曾经熟悉但如今已不再存在的地点。抵达地点On Target。 你和你的队伍 （或目标物件） 出现在你预期的地点 。 
偏离地点Off Target。 你和你的队伍（或目标物件）出现在目的地随机方向上随机距离的一点。距离误差等于原定移动距离5x1d20里，但不会超过总距离的一半。例如，假设你尝试移动250里而不幸偏离目标，并且在掷距离误差时d20结果为8，那么你的传送距离误差是原定移动位置40里，如果尝试移动20里，则做多误差不超过10里。DM通过掷一次d8 来判误差出现在目的地的哪个方向。1为正北，2为东北，3为正东，依此类推。如果你们想要传送到一个海滨城市但却出现在离岸20里远的海上，那你们可有麻烦了。 
相似地区Similar。你的目标（或目标物件）出现在一个和目的地外观或氛围相似的不同地点。例如，如果你想回你自己的研究室去，则你可能会误打误撞出现在其他法师的研究室里，或是一个陈设有许多和你的研究室里相似工具的炼金用品店。通常你会出现在离目的地最近的相似地区，但由于该法术没有距离限制，你有可能会出现在同一个位面上的任何地点。 
遇难Mishap。该法术的意外魔法效果导致这次旅行特别艰难。尝试传送的生物（或目标物件）受到2d12点力场伤害，随后DM投掷表格并查阅上表来决定你们出现在哪里（你们可能再次遇难，而每次遇难都要承受该伤害）。

target:
This spell instantly summons a shining beam of moonlight to transport one sleeping creature or object you choose to a destination of your choice. If your target is an unwilling creature, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the spell fails, and the caster appears at the target's location. A transported creature wakes immediately on arrival. If your target is an object, it must fit entirely inside a 10-foot cube and cannot be held or carried by an unwilling creature. The destination must be known to you and on the same plane as you. Your familiarity with it determines whether the creature or object arrives successfully. The DM rolls d20 and consults the Lunar Transfer table below. The following definitions are helpful:
Grove or Magic Circle means a sacred druid grove or a permanent teleportation circle whose sigil sequence you know.
Memento means that you possess an object taken from the destination within the past six months, such as a book from a wizard's library, linen from a royal bedchamber's bed, or a piece of marble from a lich's tomb.
Very Familiar means a place you visit often, have studied carefully, or can see when you cast the spell.
Seen Casually means a place you have seen a few times but do not know well.
Viewed Once means a place you have seen only once, including through magic.
Description means a place whose location and appearance you have learned from someone else, such as from a map.
False Destination means a place that does not exist. Perhaps you tried to scry an enemy's hidden chamber but saw only an illusion, or the place was once familiar but no longer exists.
On Target. You and your group, or the target object, appear where you intended.
Off Target. You and your group, or the target object, appear a random distance in a random direction from the destination. The distance error is 5x1d20 li relative to the intended travel distance, but cannot exceed half the total distance. For example, if you try to travel 250 li and arrive off target, and the d20 rolled for the distance error is 8, you arrive 40 li from your intended destination. If you try to travel 20 li, the error is at most 10 li. The DM rolls d8 to determine the direction from the destination: 1 is north, 2 northeast, 3 east, and so on. If you try to teleport to a coastal city but appear at sea 20 li offshore, you could be in trouble.
Similar Area. Your target, or the target object, appears in a different place similar in appearance or atmosphere to the destination. For example, if you try to return to your laboratory, you might instead appear in another wizard's laboratory or an alchemical supply shop containing many tools like yours. You usually appear in the similar area nearest the destination, but because the spell has no distance limit, you could appear anywhere on the same plane.
Mishap. The spell's unexpected magic makes the journey especially difficult. The creature attempting to teleport, or the target object, takes 2d12 Force damage. The DM then rolls on the table again to determine where you appear. Another mishap is possible, and each one deals this damage.

你在施法距离内的一个大型或更小的生物或物件周围产生一个闪闪发光的五彩气泡。气泡是一个半径5尺的球体，拥有10点生命值和与你的法术豁免DC相等的护甲等级。在你的每个回合开始时，气泡和其内容物会升高10尺，至多30尺。被困在气泡中的生物无法看到或听到气泡外的任何东西。且必须在其回合开始时进行一次感知豁免，否则就会被你和气泡魅惑，直到其下一回合开始，泡泡外的生物攻击泡泡前必须通过一次感知豁免，否则会被你和泡泡魅惑，直到其下一回合开始。
升环施法。当你用五环或更高环阶的法术位施展该法术时，每比四环高一环，便可额外创造一个泡泡。
target:
You create a shimmering, multicolored bubble around a Large or smaller creature or object within range. The bubble is a Sphere with a 5-foot radius, 10 Hit Points, and an Armor Class equal to your spell save DC. At the start of each of your turns, the bubble and its contents rise 10 feet, to a maximum of 30 feet. A creature trapped inside cannot see or hear anything outside the bubble. At the start of its turn, it must make a Wisdom saving throw or be Charmed by you and the bubble until the start of its next turn. Before a creature outside the bubble attacks it, that creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be Charmed by you and the bubble until the start of its next turn.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. When you cast this spell with a level 5 or higher spell slot, you can create one additional bubble for each slot level above 4.
note: The bubble itself is one of the charm sources as explicitly written. Both inside-turn and outside-before-attack saves, rise cap and per-slot bubble count are retained.

你召唤出一个传送门或门道，将施法距离内一处可见未占据空间与物质位面或妖精领域fey realms中的精确位置--如米德加德、影域Shadow Realm或盛夏之地Summer Lands——一个你曾经待过的地方。传送门是一个半圆形的开口，直径在5到20尺之间，甚至可以是大树的树根或树枝下。你可以将入口朝向你选择的任何方向。在它出现的每个位面上都有正面和背面。 穿越传送门只能通过它的正面。 这样做的任何东西都会立即传送到另一个位面，出现在离传送门最近的未占据空间里，传送门会持续很长一段时间。
神祗和其他位面统治者可以阻止此法术创建的传送门在他们面前或在其领域内的任何地方开启。
升环施法。当你用五环或更高环阶的法术位施展该法术时可以使传送门在创建后持续一周，如果使用六环级或更高法术位施展的传送门是永久的，直到用法术光耀信标Radiant Beacon（见下文）或祈愿术Wish 解除。
target:
You conjure a portal or doorway linking an unoccupied space you can see within range to an exact location on the Material Plane or in the fey realms, such as Midgard, the Shadow Realm, or the Summer Lands, where you have previously been. The portal is a semicircular opening between 5 and 20 feet in diameter, which can even be beneath the roots or branches of a great tree. You can orient the entrance in any direction you choose. It has a front and a back on each plane where it appears. The portal can be crossed only through its front. Anything doing so is instantly transported to the other plane, appearing in the unoccupied space nearest the portal. The portal lasts for a long period of time.
Deities and other planar rulers can prevent a portal created by this spell from opening in their presence or anywhere within their domains.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. When you cast this spell with a level 5 or higher spell slot, you can make the portal last one week after its creation. With a level 6 or higher spell slot, it is permanent until dispelled with Radiant Beacon (see below) or Wish.

黑雾出现时，每名位于其区域内的生物都进行一次感知豁免，豁免失败者受到5d6点心灵伤害，且在进行豁免检定受1d6减值，直至其下一回合结束。，豁免成功则仅受半伤。每当球状区域移动到一名生物区域内时、一名生物进入球状区域时或是在该区域结束其回合时，该生物同样需要进行一次豁免。一名生物一回合只进行一次该豁免。

结阵施法。将该法术被作为结阵法术施展需要至少五名辅施法者参与。除了通常的法术成分，你还需要提供一项特殊成分（三枚来自喧癫空隧的黑珍珠，串成串），作为该法术的耗材。该法术的施法距离增加至1英里，且持续时间增加为直至被解除（无需维持专注）。如果该法术的任意一名施法者参与施展了另一道作为结阵法术施展的厄难黑潮Doomtide，则该法术会提前结束。
施展该法术时，每一名辅施法者都必须消耗一枚三环及以上的法术位，否则法术失败。
target:
Choose a point within range. You create inky fog in a Sphere with a 20-foot radius centered there. The fog lasts for the duration, and its area is magical Darkness. A strong wind, such as Gust of Wind, disperses it and ends the spell.
When the fog appears, each creature in its area makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 5d6 Psychic damage and subtracts 1d6 from its saving throws until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes only half as much damage. A creature also makes this save whenever the Sphere moves into its space, it enters the Sphere, or it ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.
At the start of each of your turns, the Sphere moves 10 feet away from you.
Circle Casting. Casting this as a circle spell requires at least five assisting casters. In addition to the usual spell components, you must provide a special component, a string of three black pearls from Pandemonium, which the spell consumes. The spell's range increases to 1 mile, and its duration becomes until dispelled, without requiring Concentration. The spell ends early if any of its casters participates in casting another Doomtide as a circle spell.
When the spell is cast, every assisting caster must expend a spell slot of level 3 or higher, or the spell fails.

你咒唤一道咒火光柱，覆盖以施法范围内一点为中心，半径20尺、高20尺柱状区域。该区域内视为明亮光照，且在该区域出现时位于其中的每名生物都进行一次体质豁免，豁免失败则受到4d10光耀伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。在生物进入法术区域或在其内结束回合时，目标生物也需要进行该体质豁免。一名生物每回合仅需进行一次该豁免检定。
此外，当一名位于区域内的生物施展一道法术时，它必须进行一次体质豁免。豁免失败则法术消散且毫无效果，并且用于施展法术的动作、附赠动作或反应随之浪费。如果那道法术是使用法术位施展的，则法术位并不会被消耗。
你在施展该法术时可以指定哪些生物不受其影响。
结阵施法。除了通常的法术成分，你还需要提供一项特殊成分（一枚价值25,000+GP的星蓝宝石），作为该法术的耗材。该法术的施法距离变为1英里，且无需专注。施展该法术时，每一名辅施法者都必须消耗一枚三环及以上的法术位，否则法术失败。
升环施法。你使用的法术位每比四环高一环，法术的伤害就增加1d10。
辅施法者的数量还能影响此法术的效应区域及持续时间（如下表所示）。如果该法术的任意一名施法者参与施展了另一道作为结阵法术施展的咒火风暴Spellfire Storm，则该法术会提前结束。

context: column:M;spell:Spellfire Storm;book:被遗忘的国度：费伦英雄;level:4
target:
You call forth a column of spellfire in a Cylinder with a 20-foot radius and a height of 20 feet, centered on a point within range. The area is Bright Light. Each creature in it when it appears makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d10 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one. A creature also makes this Constitution save when it enters the spell's area or ends its turn there. A creature makes this saving throw only once per turn.
In addition, when a creature within the area casts a spell, it must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, its spell dissipates without effect, and the action, Bonus Action, or Reaction used to cast it is wasted. If the failed spell was cast with a spell slot, that slot is not expended.
When you cast this spell, you can choose which creatures are unaffected by it.
Circle Casting. In addition to the usual spell components, you must provide a special component, a star sapphire worth 25,000+ GP, which the spell consumes. The spell's range becomes 1 mile, and it requires no Concentration. When the spell is cast, every assisting caster must expend a spell slot of level 3 or higher, or the spell fails.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The spell's damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 4.
The number of assisting casters also affects the spell's area and duration, as shown below. The spell ends early if any of its casters participates in casting another Spellfire Storm as a circle spell.
Assisting Casters | Area | Duration
1-3 | Cylinder with a 40-foot radius and a height of 40 feet | 1 hour
4-6 | Cylinder with a 60-foot radius and a height of 60 feet | 8 hours
7+ | Cylinder with a 100-foot radius and a height of 100 feet | 24 hours
note: The damage-save cap is not extended to the separately introduced casting-interruption save. Failed casting wastes the action but explicitly retains a slot. All three circle rows, cost and selected-creature exclusions are retained. Second reading explicitly tied slot retention to the failed spell, avoiding an unintended benefit on a successful casting save.

物件在你的命令下“活”了过来。在施法距离内指定一定数量的未被携带或着装、也未被固定在一处表面的非超巨型非魔法物件作为法术目标。可活化物件的最大数量等于你的施法属性调整值，中型或小型目标计为一个物件，大型目标计为两个物件，巨型目标计为三个物件。
被指定的目标会活化并长出腿来，变成一名构装，并使用活化物件的数据。该生物受到你的控制，直到法术结束或其生命值降低为0。你以该法术活化的每名生物都是你的盟友（对你的其它盟友亦是如此）。它在战斗中使用你的先攻，并在你的回合结束后立即进行其回合。
直至法术结束前，你都可以使用一个附赠动作并以精神命令操纵距离你500 尺内任何你用此法术唤起的生物（如果你操纵多个生物，则你的命令可以同时传达给它们全部或是其中的某几个，不过只能使用同一种命令）。如果你不发令，它将执行回避动作且只会为躲避危险而移动。当活化物件的生命值降低为0时，它将会变回其物件形态，并且该物件将承受由活化物件形态延续而来的所有剩余伤害。
升环施法：使用五环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比五环高一环，活化物件生物的猛击Slam造成的伤害提升1d4（中型或更小）、1d6（大型）、1d12（巨型）。

巨型（或更小）的构装，无阵营

target:
Objects come to life at your command. Choose nonmagical objects within range that are not Gargantuan, are not being worn or carried, and are not fixed to a surface. The maximum number of objects you can animate equals your spellcasting ability modifier. A Medium or Small target counts as one object, a Large target as two, and a Huge target as three.
Each target animates and grows legs, becoming a Construct that uses the Animated Object stat block. It is under your control until the spell ends or its Hit Points fall to 0. Each creature animated by this spell is an ally to you and your other allies. In combat, it shares your Initiative and takes its turn immediately after yours.
Until the spell ends, you can use a Bonus Action to mentally command any creatures you animated with this spell within 500 feet of you. If you command several, you can give the same command to all or some of them, but can issue only one kind of command. Without a command, a creature takes the Dodge action and moves only to avoid danger. When an Animated Object's Hit Points fall to 0, it returns to object form, and any damage remaining from its animated form carries over to the object.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. When you cast this spell with a level 5 or higher spell slot, for each slot level above 5, the Animated Object's Slam damage increases by 1d4 for a Medium or smaller object, 1d6 for a Large object, or 1d12 for a Huge object.

Huge or smaller Construct, Unaligned
AC 15
HP 10 (Medium or smaller), 20 (Large), 40 (Huge)

source:
一道灵光从你身上延伸而出并在持续时间内形成10尺光环。这道灵光会阻绝外面除亡灵生物和构装生物之外所有类型的生物，使它们无法穿过或触及内部。一名受影响的生物施展的法术、使用远程武器或触及武器发动的攻击可以穿过屏障。
若你移动迫使受影响生物进入护罩内，则法术随之终止。
target:
An aura extends from you, forming a 10-foot Emanation for the duration. It bars all creatures other than Undead and Constructs from passing through or reaching into it. Spells cast by an affected creature, and its attacks with ranged weapons or Reach weapons, can pass through the barrier.
If you move in a way that forces an affected creature inside the shell, the spell ends.
note: Creature exclusions, attacks and spell passage, and the caster-movement termination are complete.

source:
你利用施法的时间引导一块昂贵宝石中的魔法回路，然后触碰目标。该目标必须是一个野兽或植物，且必须是一个智力小于等于3的生物或是一个并非生物的自然植物。
目标的智力会变为 10，且学会说一门你所掌握的语言。如果目标是一株自然植物，则它变为一个植物生物，并且获得使用枝、根、藤、蔓或类似部位移动的能力，和类似于人类的感官。DM 为启蒙植物决定属性数据，例子可参考《怪物图鉴》中的启蒙灌木Awakened Shrub与启蒙树木Awakened Tree 。
被启蒙的目标在 30 日内处于魅惑 状态，或是直到你或你的盟友做出任何伤害它的举动。魅惑终止后，启蒙生物自行决定对你的态度。
target:
You spend the casting time channeling the magical pathways in a costly gem, then touch the target. The target must be a Beast or plant: either a creature with an Intelligence of 3 or lower, or a natural plant that is not a creature.
The target's Intelligence becomes 10, and it learns to speak one language you know. If it is a natural plant, it becomes a Plant creature and gains the ability to move its branches, roots, vines, tendrils, or similar parts, as well as senses like a human's. The DM determines the awakened plant's statistics; Awakened Shrub and Awakened Tree in the Monster Manual are examples.
The awakened target has the Charmed condition for 30 days, or until you or your allies do anything harmful to it. When the charm ends, the awakened creature decides its attitude toward you.
note: Both target alternatives and the inclusive Intelligence limit are preserved. The source says harmful acts, not only dealing damage, for ending the charm.

source: 被该次攻击检定命中的目标会在此次攻击中额外受到5d10力场伤害。如果此次攻击将目标的生命值削减到50点或更低，则目标必须进行一次魅力豁免，豁免失败则会在法术持续期间被转移到一个无害的半位面。身处半位面期间，目标会陷入失能状态。当法术终止时，目标将重新出现在其被放逐前的位置。如果该位置被占据，则目标将出现在距离该位置最近的一个未被占据空间。
target: The target hit by this attack roll takes an extra 5d10 Force damage from the attack. If the attack reduces the target to 50 Hit Points or fewer, it must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, it is transported to a harmless demiplane for the duration. While there, it has the Incapacitated condition. When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it occupied before being banished, or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.
note: This is the supplied 2024 body: inclusive 50-HP threshold plus a Charisma save and a harmless demiplane. No other-version native-plane rule is imported.

你在施法距离内指定一处你能看见且未被占据的空间，并在该处创造出一只闪烁着魔法性微光的大型手掌。这只手会在持续时间内维持存在，并听从你的命令进行移动，模仿你自己手掌的各类动作。
这只手是一个物件，其AC为20，生命值等于你的生命值上限。如果它的生命值降至0则法术将提前终止。这只手不会占据其所处的空间。
施展此法术时，你可以令巨手移动至多60尺并造成下列效应之一。你也可以在自己随后的回合里以一个附赠动作再造成下列效应之一：
　　• 金刚拳Clenched Fist。这只手对自身周围5尺范围内的一名目标发动一次打击。进行一次近战法术攻击。若命中，则该目标受到5d8力场伤害。
　　• 飞击掌Forceful Hand。这只手尝试推撞自身周围5尺范围内的一个体型不超过巨型的生物。目标必须进行一次力量豁免，若失败，这只手会将目标推动至多等于5+你施法属性调整值的五倍的尺数。巨手将随着目标一起移动，保持自己处在目标周围5尺的范围内。
　　• 擒拿掌Grasping Hand。这只手尝试对自身周围5尺范围内的一个体型不超过巨型的生物进行擒抱。目标必须进行一次敏捷豁免，若失败，则目标陷入受擒状态，逃脱DC等于你的法术豁免DC。在这只手擒抱目标期间，你可以使用一个附赠动作命令这只手对其进行挤压，此时目标将受到4d6+你的施法属性调整值点钝击伤害。
　　• 护身掌Interposing Hand。这只手会在你对抗以其所处空间为源点发出攻击或其他效应时，以及需要穿过其所处空间的攻击以及其他效应时给予你半身掩护Half Cover。此外，这只手所处空间对你的敌人来说视作困难地形。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比五环高一环，金刚拳的伤害就会提高2d8点，擒拿掌的伤害就会提高2d6点。
target:
Choose an unoccupied space you can see within range. You create a Large hand of shimmering magical light there. It lasts for the duration and moves at your command, mimicking the motions of your own hand.
The hand is an object with AC 20 and Hit Points equal to your Hit Point maximum. The spell ends early if its Hit Points fall to 0. The hand does not occupy its space.
When you cast this spell, you can move the hand up to 60 feet and cause one of the following effects. On subsequent turns, you can also use a Bonus Action to cause one of these effects again:
• Clenched Fist. The hand strikes a target within 5 feet of itself. Make a melee spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 5d8 Force damage.
• Forceful Hand. The hand attempts to shove a Huge or smaller creature within 5 feet of itself. The target must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the hand pushes it up to a number of feet equal to 5 + five times your spellcasting ability modifier. The hand moves with the target, remaining within 5 feet of it.
• Grasping Hand. The hand attempts to grapple a Huge or smaller creature within 5 feet of itself. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it has the Grappled condition, with an escape DC equal to your spell save DC. While the hand grapples the target, you can use a Bonus Action to command it to crush the target, dealing 4d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier Bludgeoning damage.
• Interposing Hand. The hand grants you Half Cover against attacks and other effects originating in its space or passing through its space. In addition, the hand's space is Difficult Terrain for your enemies.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. For each slot level above 5, Clenched Fist's damage increases by 2d8 and Grasping Hand's damage increases by 2d6.
note: All four hand modes and their distinct saves and damage are retained. The source explicitly grants 60-foot movement when cast, then says later Bonus Actions repeat an effect; no additional movement clause is invented.

你与一名神明或一名神明的代理人进行联系，并询问至多三个能以“是”或“否”回答的问题。你必须在法术结束前完成提问。你会收到每个问题的正确答案。
这些神能存在也并非全知全能，因此当问题涉及的信息超过神的认知范围时，你可能会得到一句“不确定”作为回答。另外当一个单词的回答可能引致误导或者与神的兴致相违背时，DM 可能会提供一句短语作为答案。
若你在完成一次长休前施展两次或更多次的该法术，则法术有一定的几率不给任何答复。此概率从第二次施展起每次累计25％。
target:
You contact a deity or a deity's agent and ask up to three questions that can be answered yes or no. You must finish asking before the spell ends. You receive a correct answer to each question.
These divine beings are not all-knowing, so you might receive uncertain as an answer if a question concerns information beyond the deity's knowledge. If a one-word answer would be misleading or contrary to the deity's interests, the DM might give a short phrase instead.
If you cast this spell two or more times before finishing a Long Rest, there is a chance of receiving no answer. That chance increases cumulatively by 25 percent with each casting after the first.
note: The three-question limit, knowledge limitation and cumulative no-answer chance reset by a Long Rest are preserved.

source:
你与自然的灵魂沟通并以此获得周围环境的信息。在户外时，该法术可以让你了解3里内大地的状况。在洞穴和其他天然地下场所中，其范围缩小为300尺半径区域内。自然环境中被建筑覆盖的区域里（比如城堡或城镇中）法术无法生效。
你立即获得的自然资讯至多与该地域三个方面的主题相关，在以下项目中进行选择：
聚居地位置
通往其他位面的传送门位置
一个挑战等级10+的类型为天族、妖精、邪魔、元素或亡灵的生物（由DM选择）的位置
区域内最广泛分布的植物、矿物或动物（你选择得知其中一项）
水体的位置
例如，你可以侦测到某个强大怪物在区域中的位置、水体位置以及附近城镇的方位。
target:
You commune with nature's spirits to learn about your surroundings. Outdoors, the spell informs you about the land within 3 li. In caves and other natural underground settings, its radius is reduced to 300 feet. It does not function where construction has replaced the natural environment, such as in a castle or town.
You immediately learn information about up to three aspects of the area, chosen from the following:
The locations of settlements
The locations of portals to other planes
The location of one creature with a Challenge Rating of 10+ that is a Celestial, Fey, Fiend, Elemental, or Undead, chosen by the DM
The most widespread plant, mineral, or animal in the area, choosing one of those categories
The locations of bodies of water
For example, you could discover the location of a powerful monster in the area, the locations of bodies of water, and the direction of nearby towns.
note: Bare li remains unconverted. All five topic choices and the DM-selected single CR 10+ creature are retained, without adding topic choices from another edition.

source:
你释放出一团寒冷的空气。以你为源点的 60 尺锥状区域内的每名生物进行一次体质豁免。豁免失败受到 8d8 寒冷伤害，豁免成功则受到一半伤害。被该法术杀死的生物将成为一尊冰冻塑像直至其被解冻。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比五环高一环，法术伤害就增加1d8。
target:
You unleash a blast of cold air. Each creature in a 60-foot Cone originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 Cold damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one. A creature killed by this spell becomes a frozen statue until it thaws.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5.
note: The Cone origin, save, frozen-death consequence and scaling are retained in full.

source:
你将来自元素位面Elemental Planes的大型虚幻精魂咒唤在施法距离内一处未占据空间中。选择精魄的元素类别，这将决定它造成的伤害类型：气元素（闪电）、土元素（雷鸣）、火元素（火焰）或水元素（寒冷）。精魂在持续时间内一直存在。
每当一名你可见的生物进入精魂所在的空间或是在精魂5尺内开始其回合时，若没有生物被精魂束缚，你可以迫使其进行一次敏捷豁免检定。失败则目标受到8d8对应精魂类型的伤害并且直到法术结束为止，目标陷入束缚状态。陷入束缚状态的目标回合开始时，其重新豁免，失败则目标受到4d8对应精魂类型的伤害，豁免成功则目标不再被精魂束缚。
升环施法： 使用的法术位每比五环高一环，法术的伤害就增加2d8。
target:
You conjure a Large, intangible spirit from the Elemental Planes in an unoccupied space within range. Choose its element, which determines its damage type: Air (Lightning), Earth (Thunder), Fire (Fire), or Water (Cold). The spirit remains for the duration.
Whenever a creature you can see enters the spirit's space or starts its turn within 5 feet of it, you can force that creature to make a Dexterity saving throw, provided the spirit is not already restraining a creature. On a failed save, the target takes 8d8 damage of the spirit's type and has the Restrained condition until the spell ends. At the start of the Restrained target's turn, it repeats the save. On a failed save, it takes 4d8 damage of the spirit's type. On a successful save, the spirit no longer restrains it.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The spell's damage increases by 2d8 for each slot level above 5.
note: This spirit-area 2024 text is kept separate from older summoned-creature rules. The empty-restraint prerequisite, initial 8d8 and repeated 4d8 branches are preserved, without adding successful-save damage.

source: 你挥舞作为施法材料的武器并选择施法距离内一点。数以百计相似的幽灵武器（或是适合这把武器的弹药）齐射而出，并在之后消失。以那一点为中心，半径40尺、高20尺的柱状区域内的每名由你选择且你可见的生物进行一次敏捷豁免检定，豁免失败者将受到8d8力场伤害，豁免成功则只受一半伤害。
target: You brandish the weapon used as the spell's Material component and choose a point within range. Hundreds of similar spectral weapons, or ammunition suitable for that weapon, fly in a volley and then disappear. Each creature you choose and can see in a Cylinder centered on that point, with a 40-foot radius and a height of 20 feet, makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d8 Force damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.
note: Both chosen and visible restrict the affected creatures. Cylinder dimensions and Force damage follow the supplied source.

source:
你与一名半神、一名古老贤者的亡魂或是其他位面的博学实体建立了精神的连接。与超越人智存在的连接可能会破坏你的心智。当你施展该法术时，进行一次 DC15 的智力豁免。豁免成功时，你可以询问该实体最多五个问题。你必须在法术结束前提出你的问题。DM 将以一个单词回答你的每个问题，例如“是Yes”、“不是No”、“可能Maybe”、“不可能Never”、“无关Irrelevant”或“不清楚Unclear”（意味着该实体不知道该问题的答案）。如果一个单词的答案会造成误解，DM可能会用一句短语作为答案。
豁免失败时，你将受到6d6心灵伤害并且直到你完成一次长休为止，你陷入失能状态。对你施展法术高等复原术Greater Restoration 将结束该效应。
target:
You mentally contact a demigod, the spirit of an ancient sage, or another knowledgeable entity from another plane. Contact with a being beyond mortal understanding can damage your mind. When you cast this spell, make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw. On a successful save, you can ask the entity up to five questions before the spell ends. The DM answers each with one word, such as Yes, No, Maybe, Never, Irrelevant, or Unclear, meaning the entity does not know the answer. If a one-word answer would be misleading, the DM might answer with a short phrase.
On a failed save, you take 6d6 Psychic damage and have the Incapacitated condition until you finish a Long Rest. Greater Restoration cast on you ends this effect.
note: All six supplied example answers and the success/failure separation remain. The failure is Incapacitated until a Long Rest, not an older-version insanity rule.

source:
你的触碰会传染一道魔法疫病。目标必须成功通过一次体质豁免，否则受到11d8暗蚀伤害并陷入中毒状态。此外，当你施展法术时选择一项属性，目标在中毒期间进行所选属性的豁免检定时具有劣势。
目标在其每回合结束时必须重新豁免，直至其累计三次成功或失败。若目标累计三次成功，则结束其身上该法术的效应。若目标累计三次失败，其身上该法术的效应持续7日。
每当中毒目标受到能够结束其中毒状态的效应作用时，目标必须成功通过一次体质豁免，否则其陷入的中毒 状态不会结束。
target:
Your touch transmits a magical disease. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 11d8 Necrotic damage and have the Poisoned condition. When you cast the spell, also choose an ability. While Poisoned, the target has Disadvantage on saving throws using that ability.
At the end of each of its turns, the target must repeat the save until it has accumulated three successes or three failures. Three successes end the spell's effects on it. Three failures cause those effects to last for 7 days.
Whenever the Poisoned target is affected by an effect that could end its Poisoned condition, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or the condition does not end.
note: The ability-save penalty depends on Poisoned, which follows the failed initial save. The three-success/three-failure totals and resistance to poison-ending effects are preserved.

source:
你从堕影冥界Shadowfell取来一些暗影物质，在施法距离内创造一个物件。你可以创造一个植物质（类似纺织品、绳索、木质等）物件，也可以创造一个矿物质（类似石质、水晶、金属等）物件。创造出来的物件大小必须不超过5尺立方区域，且其必须是一种你见过的形态与材质。
法术的持续时间由所创造物件的材质决定，如材质表中所示。如果所创造物件由多种材质组合而成，则其持续时间取其中最短者。施展其他法术时，如果以这些创造物作为其材料成分将会使那道法术失败。
材质Materials 材质 持续时间 
植物 24小时 
岩石或水晶 12小时 
贵金属 1小时 
宝石 10分钟 
精金或秘银 1分钟 
升环施法：使用的法术位每比五环高一环，此法术的立方区域边长就增加5尺。
target:
You draw shadowy substance from the Shadowfell to create an object within range. You can create an object of vegetable matter, such as fabric, rope, or wood, or of mineral matter, such as stone, crystal, or metal. It must fit within a 5-foot cube and have a form and material you have seen before.
The spell's duration depends on the object's material, as shown in the Materials table. If the object combines several materials, use the shortest duration. Using any of these created objects as a Material component for another spell causes that spell to fail.
Materials
Material | Duration
Vegetable matter | 24 hours
Stone or crystal | 12 hours
Precious metals | 1 hour
Gems | 10 minutes
Adamantine or mithral | 1 minute
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The cube's side length increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 5.
note: All five material-duration rows are retained. Mixed materials use the shortest duration, and higher slots increase side length rather than volume.

source:
法术持续时间内，天族、元素、妖精、邪魔和亡灵对你的攻击检定具有劣势。你可以使用下述特殊特性之一以提前结束法术。
　　• 破咒Break Enchantment。以一个魔法动作，你触碰一名因上述生物类型的任意生物而被其附身、陷入魅惑或恐慌状态的生物。目标不再被上述生物附身，魅惑或恐慌。
　　• 驱离Dismissal。以一个魔法动作，你选择距你5尺内的一名你可见的生物，其生物类型必须是上述生物类型之一。目标必须成功于一次魅力豁免，否则，若其并未处于家园位面，则被遣送回其家园位面。对于亡灵和妖精，若它们并未处于家园位面，则亡灵会被遣送回堕影冥界Shadowfell，妖精则被遣送回妖精荒野Feywild。
context: column:M;spell:Dispel Evil and Good;book:玩家手册;level:5
target:
For the duration, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. You can end the spell early by using one of these special features:
• Break Enchantment. As a Magic action, you touch a creature possessed by a creature of one of those types or Charmed or Frightened by one. The target is no longer possessed, Charmed, or Frightened by those creatures.
• Dismissal. As a Magic action, choose a creature you can see within 5 feet of you whose type is one of those listed above. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or, if it is not on its home plane, be sent to its home plane. For Undead and Fey not on their home planes, Undead are sent to the Shadowfell and Fey to the Feywild.
note: Both actions end the spell early. The listed type restrictions, visibility and 5-foot gate, failed save and not-home-plane requirement all remain.

source:
一名法术范围内你可见的类人生物必须成功于一次感知豁免，否则在持续时间内陷入魅惑状态。若你或你的盟友正在与其战斗，则目标在此豁免上具有优势。目标受到伤害时，可以重复进行该豁免，豁免成功则其身上的此法术终止。
该目标被魅惑期间，只要你与其处于同一位面就可以与之保持心灵感应。在你的回合，你可以通过心灵感应命令该生物（无需动作），比如“攻击那个生物”“跑到那个位置”或是“去拿那个物品”。该生物会在其回合内尽其所能以遵守你的指令。目标完成一项指令却未收到你的进一步指示时，将会凭自身喜好行动，尽可能的保护自己。
你可以用自己的反应去要求目标执行一项反应。
升环施法：使用更高环阶法术位施展时，你的专注能持续更长时间：六环至多10分钟，七环至多1小时，八环及以上至多8小时。
target:
One Humanoid you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. It has Advantage on this save if you or your allies are fighting it. Whenever it takes damage, it can repeat the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.
While the target is Charmed, you can maintain telepathic contact with it as long as you are on the same plane. On your turn, you can issue telepathic commands without an action, such as attack that creature, run to that location, or fetch that object. On its turn, it does its best to obey. If it completes a command without receiving further instructions, it acts as it wishes while protecting itself as best it can.
You can use your Reaction to require the target to take a Reaction.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. Your Concentration can last longer with a higher-level slot: up to 10 minutes at level 6, up to 1 hour at level 7, or up to 8 hours at level 8 or higher.
note: Damage-triggered saves are optional as written. Same-plane telepathy, action-free own-turn commands and reaction-for-reaction control are retained; no older total-control action is added.

source:
你指定一名你知道且与你同处一个存在位面的生物。你（或你触碰的一名自愿生物）将作为信使进入出神。出神下，信使陷入失能状态且速度降为0。
如果目标正睡着，则信使可以在法术持续时间内出现在其梦中并在其沉睡期间与之交流。信使能够塑造梦中的环境，创造景观，物件和其他影像。信使可以随时结束出神状态，以此终止法术。目标在醒来后能清楚地记得其梦境的内容。
如果你施法时目标醒着，则信使可以了解到这点。此时信使可以终止出神并结束法术，或是等待目标入睡再进入其梦境。
你可以让信使以可怕的形象出现。但此时信使只能提供不超过十个单词的信息，随后目标必须成功通过一次感知豁免。豁免失败时，目标便无法从休息中获益，并在其醒来时受到3d6点心灵伤害。
target:
Choose a creature you know on the same plane of existence as you. You, or a willing creature you touch, enters a trance as a messenger. While in the trance, the messenger has the Incapacitated condition and its Speed is 0.
If the target is asleep, the messenger can appear in its dreams for the duration and communicate with it while it sleeps. The messenger can shape the dream's environment, creating landscapes, objects, and other images. It can end the trance at any time, ending the spell. The target remembers the dream clearly after waking.
If the target is awake when you cast the spell, the messenger learns that fact. It can end the trance and spell, or wait for the target to fall asleep and then enter its dreams.
You can make the messenger appear terrifying. In this case, it can deliver a message of no more than ten words, after which the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target gains no benefit from its rest and takes 3d6 Psychic damage when it wakes.
note: The nightmare rest denial and waking damage stay in the failed-save branch. No source-external sleep or physical-remains rule is added.

source:
一支辉煌火焰的立柱从上方呼啸着降落。位于以施法范围内一点为中心，半径10尺、高40尺柱状区域内的每个生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败者将受到5d6点火焰伤害和5d6点光耀伤害，豁免成功则只受到一半伤害。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比五环高一环，其火焰伤害和光耀伤害就均增加1d6。
target:
A column of brilliant flame roars down from above. Each creature in a Cylinder centered on a point within range, with a 10-foot radius and a height of 40 feet, must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 5d6 Fire damage and 5d6 Radiant damage. On a successful save, it takes only half as much damage.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. Both the Fire and Radiant damage increase by 1d6 for each slot level above 5.
note: Both damage types increase per level; neither is replaced by a choice of one type.

source:
你对施法距离内你能看见的一个生物下达一条魔法口头命令，并强迫其执行相应的某种服务或克制某种行为，或者遵照你的要求行动。目标必须成功通过一次感知豁免，否则将在法术持续时间内陷入魅惑状态。目标不能理解你的命令，则其在豁免中自动成功。
被魅惑生物每次做出与你的命令相悖的行为时，即受到5d10点心灵伤害。该伤害一日至多生效一次。
除了涉及导致必死结果的行为外，你向目标下达的任何命令都会生效。如果你发布自杀指令则法术即时终止。
一道移除诅咒Remove Curse，高等复原术Greater Restoration或祈愿术Wish 可以终止该法术。
升环施法：使用七环或八环法术位施展该法术时，持续时间变为365日。使用九环法术位施展该法术时，法术将一直持续至被上文提及的法术所终止。
target:
You give a magical spoken command to a creature you can see within range, compelling it to perform a service, refrain from a behavior, or act as you direct. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. If it cannot understand your command, it automatically succeeds on the save.
Whenever the Charmed creature acts contrary to your command, it takes 5d10 Psychic damage. This damage can occur at most once per day.
You can issue any command except one that would certainly result in death. If you give a suicidal command, the spell immediately ends.
Remove Curse, Greater Restoration, or Wish can end this spell.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. With a level 7 or 8 spell slot, the duration becomes 365 days. With a level 9 spell slot, the spell lasts until ended by one of the spells listed above.
note: The comprehension auto-success, once-per-day cap and suicidal-command termination remain. Only source-listed higher slots receive altered durations.

source:
你触碰一名生物并魔法性地移除目标身上的下列效应之一：
　　• 1级力竭
　　• 魅惑或石化状态
　　• 一道诅咒，包括目标因与一件被诅咒魔法物品的同调所陷入的诅咒。
　　• 目标某项属性值的减损
　　• 目标生命值上限的降低
target:
You touch a creature and magically remove one of the following effects from it:
• 1 level of Exhaustion
• The Charmed or Petrified condition
• One curse, including a curse caused by the target's Attunement to a cursed magic item
• A reduction to one of the target's ability scores
• A reduction to the target's Hit Point maximum
note: Exactly one listed effect is removed; all five options and the cursed-attunement inclusion are retained.

source:
你触碰一点并将神圣（或邪秽）的力量注入该点周围区域。区域半径至多 60 尺，若此区域内包含了已被另一个圣居影响的区域，则此次施法失败。受法术影响的区域具有以下效应。
神圣防护 Hallowed Ward。选择以下生物类型的任何一种：异怪，天族，元素，妖精，邪魔，亡灵。所选类型生物不能自愿进入该区域，任何被这些生物魅惑，恐慌或附身的生物只要在该区域内将不再被他们魅惑，恐慌或附身。

额外效果Extra Effect。你可以为该区域绑定下列其中一种额外效应，：
　　• 无畏 Courage。你选择的任何类型的生物在该区域内时不会陷入恐慌状态。
　　• 黑暗 Darkness。区域内处于黑暗环境，普通光源以及比本法术更低环法术所创造的魔法光源均无法照亮该区域。
　　• 昼明Daylight。区域内处于明亮光照，比本法术更低环法术所创造的魔法黑暗无法掩盖亮光。
　　• 平静长眠 Peaceful Rest。区域内埋葬的尸体不能被转化成亡灵。
　　• 次元干涉Extradimensional Interference。你选择的任何类型的生物均不能通过传送或者位面旅行的方式进入或离开该区域。
　　• 恐惧Fear。你所选择的任何类型的生物在该区域内时陷入恐慌状态。
　　• 抗性Resistance。你所选择的任何类型的生物在该区域内时，对你所选择的一种伤害类型具有抗性。
　　• 沉默Silence。声音无法从区域内发出，区域外的声音也不能传到区域内。
　　• 巧言Tongues。你所选择的任何类型生物与区域内的任何其他生物即使语言不通也可以随意交流。
　　• 易伤Vulnerability。区域内你所选择的任何类型生物具有你所选择的一种伤害类型的易伤。
target:
You touch a point and infuse the surrounding area with holy or unholy power. The area has a radius of up to 60 feet. If it includes an area already affected by another Hallow, this casting fails. The affected area has the following effects.
Hallowed Ward. Choose any one of these creature types: Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead. Creatures of the chosen type cannot willingly enter the area. Any creature Charmed, Frightened, or possessed by one of them is no longer Charmed, Frightened, or possessed by them while in the area.

Extra Effect. You can bind one of the following additional effects to the area:
• Courage. Creatures of any types you choose cannot have the Frightened condition while in the area.
• Darkness. The area is in Darkness. Ordinary light sources and magical light created by spells of a lower level than this spell cannot illuminate it.
• Daylight. The area is Bright Light. Magical Darkness created by spells of a lower level than this spell cannot obscure the light.
• Peaceful Rest. Corpses buried in the area cannot be turned into Undead.
• Extradimensional Interference. Creatures of any types you choose cannot enter or leave the area by teleportation or planar travel.
• Fear. Creatures of any types you choose have the Frightened condition while in the area.
• Resistance. Creatures of any types you choose have Resistance to one damage type you choose while in the area.
• Silence. Sound cannot emerge from within the area, and sound from outside cannot enter it.
• Tongues. Creatures of any types you choose can freely communicate with any other creature in the area even if they do not share a language.
• Vulnerability. Creatures of any types you choose in the area have Vulnerability to one damage type you choose.
note: All ten extra effects and the initial single-type ward are retained. Overlap causes casting failure, willing entry is the ward restriction, and no source-external saves or exception selection is added.

source:
指定施法距离内一个你能看见的生物。该目标必须进行一次感知豁免，豁免失败则其在法术持续时间内陷入麻痹状态。目标在其每回合结束时可以重新进行这次豁免，豁免成功则终止其身上该法术的效应。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比五环高一环，你就可以额外指定一个生物作为此法术的目标。
target:
Choose one creature you can see within range. It must make a Wisdom saving throw, having the Paralyzed condition for the duration on a failed save. At the end of each of its turns, it can repeat the save, ending the spell's effect on itself on a success.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each slot level above 5.
note: The source has no Undead exclusion or inter-target spacing requirement; neither is added from another edition.

source:
你指定施法距离内一点，并以该点为中心使半径 20 尺球状区域内堆满成群的噬人蝗虫。虫群使整个区域成为困难地形并处于轻度遮蔽，在法术终止前都会持续存在。
当虫群显现时，区域内的每个生物都必须进行一次体质豁免，豁免失败则受到4d10穿刺伤害，成功则受到半数伤害。生物在一个回合内第一次进入该区域内，或者在区域内结束其回合时，也必须进行该豁免。一名生物每回合仅需进行一次该豁免。
升环施法： 使用六环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比五环高一环，伤害就增加1d10。
target:
Choose a point within range. Swarming, flesh-eating locusts fill a Sphere with a 20-foot radius centered there. The swarm makes the area Difficult Terrain and Lightly Obscured, lasting until the spell ends.
When the swarm appears, each creature in the area must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d10 Piercing damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one. A creature must also make this save when it enters the area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. When you cast this spell with a level 6 or higher spell slot, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 5.
note: Initial appearance, first entry and end-turn triggers share the explicit once-per-turn limit; terrain, obscurity and scaling are all retained.

source:
你以施法距离内你能看到的一点为中心，创造出一场闪光和雷鸣交织的风暴，席卷10尺半径、40尺高度的柱状区域。在这片区域内，生物会陷入目盲和耳聋状态，并且不能施展任何含有声音成分的法术。
当风暴出现时，任何处于其中的生物都必须进行一次体质豁免，豁免失败则受到2d10点光耀伤害与2d10点雷鸣伤害，豁免成功受到半数伤害。生物在一个回合内首次进入该区域内，或者在区域内结束其回合时，也必须进行该豁免。一名生物每回合仅需进行一次该豁免。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比五环高一环，此法术的光耀和雷鸣伤害都回增加1d10。
context: column:M;spell:Jailarzi's Storm of Radiance;book:玩家手册;level:5
target:
You create a storm of flashing light and thunder in a Cylinder with a 10-foot radius and a height of 40 feet, centered on a point you can see within range. Creatures in the area have the Blinded and Deafened conditions and cannot cast any spell with a Verbal component.
When the storm appears, each creature in it must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d10 Radiant damage and 2d10 Thunder damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one. A creature must also make this save when it enters the area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. Both the Radiant and Thunder damage increase by 1d10 for each slot level above 5.
note: The area conditions and Verbal-component prohibition are unconditional, while damage uses the save. The same-row English name is retained as context without silently correcting its spelling.

source:
点名或描述一个著名的人物，地点，或物件。该法术在你脑海中形成一段由DM描述的关于该事物重要传闻的简单概述。
这些传闻可能包括了重要的细节，有趣的揭秘，也可能是不曾被广泛知晓的秘闻。你掌握目标越多的信息，所得到的信息就越精确细致。你由此得到的信息必定是准确的，但仍可能会以比喻或诗歌来表达，具体将由DM决定。
如果你选的事物其实并不著名，你会听到仿佛由长号演奏而出的悲伤的音符，随后法术失败。
target:
Name or describe a famous person, place, or object. The spell brings to your mind a brief summary, described by the DM, of significant lore about that subject.
This lore might include important details, interesting revelations, or secrets that are not widely known. The more you already know about the target, the more precise and detailed the information you receive. The information is necessarily accurate, but the DM might express it through metaphor or poetry.
If the subject you chose is not actually famous, you hear sad notes as if played on a trombone, and the spell fails.
note: The explicit sad-trombone failure and accurate-but-possibly-figurative information are retained; no different fame threshold is substituted.

source:
一道治愈能量从施法距离内你指定的一点涤荡而出。你在该点周边30尺半径的球状区域内指定至多六个生物，并使每个目标生物恢复 5d8+你的施法属性调整值 点生命值。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比五环高一环，法术的治疗量就增加1d8。
target:
A wave of healing energy washes out from a point you choose within range. Choose up to six creatures in a Sphere with a 30-foot radius centered on that point. Each target regains 5d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier Hit Points.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5.
note: The six-target Sphere, base 5d8 healing and slot scaling are complete. No creature-type exclusion absent from the source is added.

source:
你获得隐形状态，同时在你站的地方出现一个和你一样的幻象分身。分身会持续存在至法术持续时间结束；但如果你发动攻击、造成伤害或施展法术，则隐形随之结束。
以一个魔法动作，你可以令分身以至多两倍于你的速度移动并可以令其打手势、说话，以及以任何你指定的方式行事。分身无法被触及且无法受伤。
你可以通过分身的眼睛视物，用分身的耳朵聆听，如同你处于它的位置一样。
target:
You gain the Invisible condition, and an illusory double of you appears where you are standing. The double lasts for the spell's duration, but the invisibility ends if you make an attack, deal damage, or cast a spell.
As a Magic action, you can move the double up to twice your Speed and make it gesture, speak, and behave in any way you choose. The double cannot be touched or harmed.
You can see through the double's eyes and hear through its ears as though you were in its space.
note: Attack, dealing damage and casting are three independent invisibility-ending triggers. The double continues for the duration; no older sensory-switch action is added.

source:
你尝试重塑另一个生物的记忆。指定施法距离内一个你能看见的生物进行一次感知豁免。如果你正与该生物战斗，则它进行该豁免时具有优势。豁免失败时，该生物会在法术持续时间内陷入魅惑状态。被魅惑的目标陷入失能状态且无法感知周边的事物，但它仍然能听到你的声音。如果它受到任何伤害或者成为另一个法术的目标，则该法术终止且目标的记忆不会被修改。
该魅惑持续时，你可以改变目标关于过去 24 小时内经历的一个持续时间不超过十分钟的事件记忆。你可以永久地消除所有关于该事件的记忆，也可以让目标完美清晰地回忆起该事件的所有细节，还可以改变目标关于该事件记忆细节，或是创造一段关于其他事情的记忆。
你必须通过对目标说话来描述如何改变其记忆，并且目标必须能够听懂你的语言以便你植入被改变后的记忆。目标的意识会将你描述中所有缺失的细节填补完全。如果法术在你描述完被修改的记忆前就结束，则目标的记忆不会被改变。反之修改过的记忆会在法术终止时根植于目标心中。
修改过的记忆不一定会影响生物的行为，特别是当修改后的记忆违背了目标的天性，阵营或信仰时。如果植入一段不合逻辑的记忆（例如给目标灌输它有多么享受在强酸中泡澡的记忆），则目标会将其视为一场噩梦而加以忽视。DM 也可以判定某段修改过的记忆太过荒谬，故而无法影响生物。
对目标施展法术移除诅咒Remove Curse或高等复原术Greater Restoration后即可使目标恢复真实的记忆。
升环施法：使用五环以上的法术位时，你可以改变目标关于过去 7 日内（六环）、30 日内（七环）、1 年内（八环）或者在过去任意时刻（九环）所发生事件的记忆。
target:
You attempt to reshape another creature's memories. Choose a creature you can see within range to make a Wisdom saving throw. If you are fighting it, it has Advantage on the save. On a failed save, it has the Charmed condition for the duration. The Charmed target is Incapacitated and unaware of its surroundings, but can still hear your voice. If it takes any damage or becomes the target of another spell, this spell ends without changing its memories.
While the charm lasts, you can alter the target's memory of one event it experienced within the past 24 hours that lasted no more than ten minutes. You can permanently erase all memory of that event, allow it to recall every detail with perfect clarity, change details of the memory, or create a memory of something else.
You must speak to the target to describe the changes, and it must understand your language for you to implant the altered memory. Its mind fills in missing details in your description. If the spell ends before you finish describing the altered memory, its memory is unchanged. Otherwise, the altered memory takes root when the spell ends.
An altered memory does not necessarily change a creature's behavior, especially if it contradicts its nature, alignment, or beliefs. An illogical memory, such as one of enjoying a bath in acid, is dismissed as a bad dream. The DM can also decide that an altered memory is too absurd to affect the creature.
Remove Curse or Greater Restoration cast on the target restores its true memories.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. With a spell slot above level 5, you can alter memories of events within the past 7 days at level 6, 30 days at level 7, 1 year at level 8, or any time in the past at level 9.
note: All interruption conditions, four editing options, language/completion prerequisites, behavioral limitations and four higher-slot age limits are retained. Combat Advantage refers to you, not an added ally condition.

source:
一处通道在施法距离内木质、泥灰、或岩石表面（如墙壁、天花板、地板）上你可见的一点出现，且持续至法术结束。由你选择开口的大小，其至多宽5尺，高8尺，深20尺。通道不会使其周围的结构变得不稳定。
开口消失时，任何仍旧位于通道中的生物或物件会被安全地弹射到距你施展此法术时选择的表面最近的一处未占据空间中。
target:
A passage appears at a point you can see on a wooden, plaster, or stone surface within range, such as a wall, ceiling, or floor, and lasts until the spell ends. You choose the opening's dimensions, up to 5 feet wide, 8 feet high, and 20 feet deep. It does not destabilize the surrounding structure.
When the opening disappears, any creature or object still in the passage is safely ejected to the unoccupied space nearest the surface you chose when casting the spell.
note: All three dimensions, allowed materials and the original selected surface as the ejection reference are retained.

source:
你试图誓缚一名生物类型为天族、元素、妖精或邪魔的生物使其为你服务。生物必须在施法过程中一直位于施法距离内。（通常来说，在施展该法术期间，生物会先被召唤到一道反向作用的防护法阵Magic Circle中困住。）施法完成时，目标必须成功通过一次魅力豁免，否则在持续时间内必须为你服务。如果生物是由另一道法术召唤或创造的，则那道法术的持续时间会被延长到与此法术的持续时间一致。
一名被誓缚的生物必须尽其最大的努力遵循你的命令。你可能命令该生物在你冒险时陪伴你，或守卫一个地点，又或者传递一个信息。如果此生物与你敌对，则它会努力曲解你的字面意思来达到它自己的目标。如果生物在法术终止前完全执行了你的指示而你们仍处于同一位面，则它会当面向你汇报。如果你们处于不同位面，则它会回到与其建立誓约之地，并停留该处直至法术终止。
升环施法：使用更高环法术位施展该法术时，法术持续时间增加：六环10日，七环30日，八环180日，九环366日。
target:
You attempt to bind a Celestial, Elemental, Fey, or Fiend to your service. The creature must remain within range throughout the casting. It is usually first summoned into an inverted Magic Circle and trapped there while this spell is cast. When the casting is complete, the target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or serve you for the duration. If another spell summoned or created it, that spell's duration is extended to match this spell's duration.
A bound creature must follow your instructions to the best of its ability. You might command it to accompany you on an adventure, guard a location, or deliver a message. If it is hostile to you, it tries to twist the literal wording of your commands to further its own ends. If it finishes your instructions before the spell ends and you are still on the same plane, it reports to you in person. If you are on different planes, it returns to the place where you bound it and remains there until the spell ends.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The duration increases with a higher-level slot: 10 days at level 6, 30 days at level 7, 180 days at level 8, or 366 days at level 9.
note: The source specifies 366 days at level 9; it is retained. Continuous casting range, summoning-duration extension and the two reporting-location branches remain complete.

source:
你触碰一名已死，但死亡时间不超过10日，且死亡时并非亡灵Undead的生物，使其回生。
生物以1点生命值重生。该法术同样会中和在该生物死亡时仍在生效的毒素。
该法术能治愈所有致命伤，但无法恢复失去的身体部位。如果该生物缺失了它生存所必要的身体部位或器官（比如头），则该法术自动失败。
死而复生是一个痛苦的体验。目标进行D20检定时具有-4减值。目标每完成一次长休，其减值就减少1，直至减值变为0。
target:
You touch and restore to life a dead creature that has been dead for no more than 10 days and was not Undead when it died.
The creature returns with 1 Hit Point. This spell also neutralizes any poison that was affecting it when it died.
The spell heals all mortal wounds but does not restore missing body parts. If the creature lacks a body part or organ necessary for survival, such as its head, the spell automatically fails.
Returning from death is painful. The target has a -4 penalty to D20 Tests. Each time it finishes a Long Rest, the penalty decreases by 1 until it reaches 0.
note: The inclusive ten-day limit, type at death, missing-vital-part failure and D20 penalty recovery are preserved. No soul-consent or disease rule absent from this body is added.

source:
你使得施法距离内你选择的至多八名自愿生物在法术持续时间内建立心灵连线。不能以任何语言进行沟通的生物不受该法术影响。
直到法术终止，所有受术生物都可以通过心灵连线与其他受术生物进行心灵感应，不论他们是否语言相通。该交流方式可以跨越任意距离，但不能跨过存在位面。
target:
You create a telepathic link among up to eight willing creatures you choose within range for the duration. Creatures that cannot communicate in any language are unaffected.
Until the spell ends, all affected creatures can communicate telepathically with one another through the link, whether or not they share a language. This communication works across any distance, but not across planes of existence.
note: The language-capability exclusion differs from an Intelligence threshold; only the source requirement is used.

source:
你触及一名类人生物的遗体或遗体的一部分。若该生物死亡时间不超过10日，则法术会创造出一具新的成年身体，并呼唤该生物的灵魂进入此新身躯。骰1d10，然后参照下表来决定新躯体的种族，或者DM也可以选择其他可选种族。

1d10 种族  1d10 种族 
1 阿斯莫  6 歌利亚 
2 龙裔  7 半身人 
3 矮人  8 人类 
4 精灵  9 兽人 
5 侏儒  10 提夫林 
若种族描述中提供了可选选项，则由被转生的生物做出选择，且其保留其前生记忆。目标保留原形的一切能力，不过其种族特质将以新种族的相应特质做更替。
target:
You touch a dead Humanoid or part of its remains. If it has been dead for no more than 10 days, the spell creates a new adult body and calls its soul to enter that body. Roll 1d10 and consult the table to determine the new body's species, or the DM can choose another available species.

1d10 | Species | 1d10 | Species
1 | Aasimar | 6 | Goliath
2 | Dragonborn | 7 | Halfling
3 | Dwarf | 8 | Human
4 | Elf | 9 | Orc
5 | Gnome | 10 | Tiefling
If the species description offers choices, the reincarnated creature makes them. It retains its memories from its previous life. The target retains all the capabilities of its original form, but its species traits are replaced by the corresponding traits of its new species.
note: All ten die-to-species mappings and the creature-owned optional choices are retained. No additional species, consent clause or older table is imported.

source:
你能看见和听见一个和你处于同一存在位面上的生物。目标生物必须进行一次感知豁免；该豁免的调整值与你对目标的了解程度有关（见下文），也与你和目标之间的物理联系程度有关。目标不知道它进行此豁免在对抗什么，只是会感觉不自在。

你对目标的了解有… 豁免调整值  你对目标的了解有… 豁免调整值 
二手信息（你曾经听说过目标） +5  肖像或其他图像 -2 
直接信息（你曾经见过目标） +0  衣物或其他物品 -4 
熟悉（你对目标很了解） -5  身体部位如头发或指甲 -10 

如果对方豁免成功，则目标不受该法术影响，并且在 24 小时内你无法再次对其施展该法术。
如果对方豁免失败，则你在目标身边 10 尺内创造出一个隐形且不具备实体的传感器。通过传感器，你可以身临其境地看见和听见周围的环境。传感器会跟随目标移动，并在法术持续时间内始终保持在目标 10 尺之内。在能够看到传感器的生物眼中，你的传感器是一个与你的拳头一般大小的光球。
除生物之外，你也可以选择一个你以前见过的地点作为该法术的目标。这种情况下，传感器会出现在目标地点且不会移动。
target:
You can see and hear a creature on the same plane of existence as you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw, modified by how well you know it and by your physical connection to it, as shown below. The target does not know what this save opposes; it merely feels uneasy.

Knowledge of Target | Save Modifier | Connection to Target | Save Modifier
Secondhand information (you have heard of the target) | +5 | Portrait or other likeness | -2
Firsthand information (you have seen the target) | +0 | Clothing or another possession | -4
Familiar (you know the target well) | -5 | Body part, such as hair or a nail | -10

On a successful save, the target is unaffected, and you cannot cast this spell on it again for 24 hours.
On a failed save, you create an Invisible, intangible sensor within 10 feet of the target. Through it, you can see and hear the surroundings as though you were there. The sensor follows the target, remaining within 10 feet of it for the duration. To a creature that can see it, the sensor appears as a glowing orb the size of your fist.
Instead of a creature, you can target a place you have seen before. In this case, the sensor appears at that location and does not move.
note: All six modifiers and the distinction between knowledge and physical connection are retained. The repeated source table heading is clarified from its own column contents. The target feels uneasy without knowing the save purpose.

source:
你选择施法距离内你能看见的任意数量生物，为他们提供一个虚假外观。不愿意受该法术影响的目标可以进行一次魅力豁免，豁免成功则不受该法术影响。
你可以为不同目标提供同样或不同的外观。法术能改变生物的身体和装备外观。你可以让目标看起来身高有 1 尺的增减，看上去更轻或更重。目标的新形貌的肢体结构必须与目标原形相符，但你可以随意改变其他的外观特征。法术会持续至时间结束。
此法术产生的变化无法应对物理检查。比如，你用此法术为一个生物添了一顶帽子，那么现实物件会穿过帽子。
一个使用研究动作来检查目标的生物可以进行一次智力（调查）检定来对抗你的法术豁免DC。如果它成功了，它会意识到目标进行了伪装。
target:
Choose any number of creatures you can see within range and give them false appearances. An unwilling target can make a Charisma saving throw, remaining unaffected on a success.
You can give the targets identical or different appearances. The spell changes the appearance of their bodies and equipment. You can make a target appear 1 foot taller or shorter, and lighter or heavier. Its new appearance must have the same arrangement of limbs as its original form, but you can otherwise change its appearance as you wish. The spell lasts for the duration.
These changes do not withstand physical inspection. For example, if you use the spell to add a hat to a creature, physical objects pass through the hat.
A creature that takes the Study action to examine a target can make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. On a success, it realizes the target is disguised.
note: Unwilling targets may save; bodily structure is retained while appearance changes. The Study action and recognition result follow the supplied 2024 source.

source:
你舞动用于施法的武器，随后忽然消失并如疾风般发起一轮突击。选择施法距离内最多5个你可见的生物。向每个生物分别进行一次近战法术攻击。若命中，目标将受到6d10点力场伤害。
在这之后，你可以传送到法术目标之一周围5尺内一处你可以看见且未占据空间中。
target:
You flourish the weapon used to cast the spell, then suddenly vanish and strike like the wind. Choose up to 5 creatures you can see within range. Make a separate melee spell attack against each. On a hit, a target takes 6d10 Force damage.
Afterward, you can teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of one of the spell's targets.
note: The final teleport is optional and can use any target, without an added successful-hit requirement.

source:
你唤来一个天界灵魄。其使用下文天界灵魄的数据，并会在施法距离内一处你可见的未被占据的空间中显现。当你施展法术时，从复仇圣灵或守护圣灵选择一个，其数据中的部分特性也受此影响。该生物会在生命值降为0或是法术结束时消失。
该生物是你的盟友（对你的其它盟友亦是如此）。它在战斗中使用你的先攻，并在你回合结束后立即行动。它遵从于你的口头指令（无需任何动作）。如果你不发令，它将执行回避动作并远离危险。
升环施法：该生物的数据使用新的法术环阶。

天界灵魄Celestial Spirit 
大型天族，绝对中立
AC 11+法术环阶+2（仅守护圣灵）
HP 40+每比5环高的法术环阶10点
速度30尺，飞行40尺
力量16|+3|+3 敏捷14|+2|+2 体质16|+3|+3
智力10|+0|+0 感知14|+2|+2 魅力16|+3|+3

target:
Choose a point within range and cause psychic energy to erupt there. Each creature in a Sphere with a 20-foot radius centered on that point makes an Intelligence saving throw, taking 8d6 Psychic damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.
A target that fails the save also has muddled thoughts for the next 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the target can repeat the Intelligence saving throw, ending this effect on itself on a success.
note: Muddled thoughts are restricted to failure. The Constitution penalty applies only to Concentration saves, not all Constitution saves; no Intelligence-based immunity absent from the source is added.

如果该物件已被一名生物着装或携带，则该生物必须成功于一次力量豁免，否则你可以把目标物件从该生物身上驱离，并且使该物体在施法范围内朝任意方向移动至多30尺。
你可以使用心灵遥控对物件进行精密操作，例如操纵一件简单的工具，打开一扇门或一个容器，把东西放进或拿出一个打开的容器中，或是把一个小瓶子里的东西倒出来。
target:
You gain the ability to move or manipulate creatures or objects with your mind. When you cast this spell, and as a Magic action on subsequent turns until it ends, you can exert your will on one creature or object you can see within range, causing the corresponding effect below. You can affect the same target round after round or choose a new one at any time. If you change targets, the previous target is no longer affected.
• Creature. You can attempt to move a Huge or smaller creature. The target must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, you can move it up to 30 feet in any direction within range, and it has the Restrained condition until the end of your next turn. If you lift it into the air, it remains suspended there. Unless you use this option on the suspended creature again and it fails the save, it falls at the end of your next turn.
• Object. You can attempt to move a Huge or smaller object. If it is not worn or carried, you automatically move it up to 30 feet in any direction within range.
If the object is worn or carried by a creature, that creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw, or you can pull the object away and move it up to 30 feet in any direction within range.
You can use Telekinesis for fine manipulation, such as using a simple tool, opening a door or container, putting an object into or taking it out of an open container, or pouring the contents of a vial.
note: Creature movement and restraint are inside the failed-save case; switching targets ends the prior effect. Huge-or-smaller object size and saves are preserved instead of an older weight or contested-check rule. Second reading explicitly joined movement and restraint under the failed save and retained the caster option to move it.

许多大神殿、公会大厅和其他重要的场所都设有永久的传送法阵。这种法阵各有自己独一无二的印记序列，即按特定顺序排列的一串魔法符文。
你第一次获得施展该法术的能力时，你会习得物质位面上两个永久法阵的印记序列（由DM决定），随后你还可以在旅途中习得更多的印记序列。你只要花一分钟仔细研究一个新的印记序列就能够将其记录下来。
当你每日对同一地点连续施展该法术持续365天之后，将创造出一个永久的传送法阵。

When you cast this spell, you draw a circle with a 5-foot radius on the ground and inscribe sigils around it. It links your location to a permanent teleportation circle you choose on the same plane, whose sigil sequence you must know. A glowing portal opens in the circle and remains open until the end of your next turn. Any creature entering it instantly appears within 5 feet of the destination circle, or in the unoccupied space nearest that circle if that space is occupied.
Many major temples, guild halls, and other important places have permanent teleportation circles. Each has a unique sigil sequence, a series of magical runes in a particular arrangement.
When you first gain the ability to cast this spell, you learn the sigil sequences of two permanent circles on the Material Plane, chosen by the DM. You can learn more during your travels. You can record a new sigil sequence by studying it carefully for one minute.
Casting this spell in the same location every day for 365 consecutive days creates a permanent teleportation circle.
note: The same-plane known-sequence prerequisite, next-turn closing time, arrival fallback and explicit 365 consecutive days are all retained.

在你的每个回合内，你仅能使用这样的输送能力一次。而且你必须在树外结束你的回合。
target:
You can enter a tree and move from inside it to another tree of the same kind within 500 feet. Both trees must be alive and at least as large as you. Entering a tree costs 5 feet of movement. Once inside, you immediately know the locations of all trees of the same kind within 500 feet. As part of the movement used to enter, you can move to one of those trees or step out of the tree you are in. You appear at a point you choose within 5 feet of the destination tree, spending another 5 feet of movement. If your movement is already exhausted, you appear somewhere within 5 feet of the tree you entered.
You can use this transportation only once on each of your turns, and you must end your turn outside a tree.
note: Both 5-foot movement costs, the source exhausted-movement return to the entry tree, same-kind living-tree requirement and once-per-own-turn limit are retained.
